setup.intro: Install and manage Klipper-ecosystem components for this printer.
setup.onHostHint: This component installs on the printer host; open its Source for the steps.
setup.writesOff: Installing from here is turned off. Enable it to install, update and remove components directly.

autoUpdate.title: Automatic updates
autoUpdate.hint: Updates are applied only while the printer is idle, never mid-print.

overview.title: Managing components
overview.body: Browse the catalog by section; each card shows whether it's installed and its version. Install, update and remove run on the printer host and stay off here until you enable them. Turn on Automatic updates to keep everything current while the printer is idle.
